JUDGE BURST K2p-jdg-E — the Keeper's E-facing rest frames: equipment GEOMETRY verified by occlusion, not by claim (Matt's question 2026-09-12: is the staff in the wrong hand? is the satchel at the front instead of the side?). task_id "K2p-jdg-E". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 = the APPROVED MASTER (direction S, facing the camera): her RIGHT hand holds the staff (on SCREEN-LEFT when she faces you); ONE harness strap runs from her RIGHT shoulder to her LEFT hip, where an olive satchel hangs AT HER SIDE. Images 2, 3, 4, 5 = four candidates that all claim direction E (full profile, facing screen-right); judge each independently; do not assume any is a control.
DERIVED GEOMETRY for E (from the master): she faces screen-right, so her LEFT side is NEAR the camera and her RIGHT side is FAR. Correct: (a) the staff is in her FAR (right) hand — the tell is OCCLUSION: the staff arm's shoulder/upper arm is hidden behind the torso and the near (left) arm is the one fully visible; a staff held by the NEAR hand shows that arm's full shoulder and upper arm in front of the torso; (b) the satchel hangs at her near LEFT hip AT HER SIDE — over the hip/thigh, its body overlapping the leg — NOT swung to the front of the hip beside the belt buckle; (c) the strap crosses the chest FRONT emerging from behind the neck (far shoulder) — the visible near shoulder is BARE; (d) nose, chest and boot toes point screen-right; a candidate facing screen-LEFT is mirrored (then the staff would sit in the near hand and the satchel on the far hip).
For EACH candidate answer, with the visible evidence in one line each: staff_hand = "far" | "near" | "cannot tell" (name the occlusion evidence); satchel = "side" | "front" | "absent"; strap_over_near_shoulder = true | false; facing = "right" | "left"; mirrored = true | false; then score axes 1–5 (1–5 integers, one-line reasons): 1 register fidelity (hand-drawn tapered contour, painted planes) · 2 identity fidelity to Image 1 (face, hair mass, costume, colours) · 3 light obedience (key from screen upper-left — the key-facing side is the screen-left side; a candidate lit from upper-right scores ≤ 2) · 4 equipment geometry per (a)–(d) (all four correct = 5; each error −1) · 5 profile quality (a true profile: one eye, one ear line, chest facing screen-right).
Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":2,"staff_hand":"…","staff_evidence":"…","satchel":"…","strap_over_near_shoulder":bool,"facing":"…","mirrored":bool,"axes":{"1":n,"2":n,"3":n,"4":n,"5":n},"reasons":{"1":"…",…}}, …]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K2p-jdg-E"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — scores only.
